tools.name: agent.create
tools.note: from a template id or a plain-words description (llm purpose 'compile'); always a draft, linted

tools.name: agent.get
tools.note: draft, draftHash, lint, budget meters, compiled brief preview, stack card, versions, tests

tools.name: brief.edit
tools.note: validated patch (set/remove/append by path); voice/tools/ids locked; optional expectDraftHash

tools.name: stack.list
tools.note: default: null; replyGap figure with grade and source per stack; price reads not_measured

tools.name: stack.set
tools.note: only finalised stacks from shared/stacks.ts; changing stack clears the voice

tools.name: voice.set
tools.note: refuses until a stack is chosen

tools.name: tool.attach
tools.note: catalogue tools by name with fixed risk, or workspace tool rows by id; remove: true detaches

tools.name: test.simulate
tools.note: LLM caller (purpose 'simulate') from sim_caller; every agent sentence through replyDoor; graded by code; stored in agent_test_run; simCallerId(s) accept 'default:<slug>' library ids or saved caller uuids

tools.name: version.publish
tools.note: A2; version() = draft hash; stores agent_version.config = { agent, brief } with versionHash and parent

tools.name: deployment.split
tools.note: A2; version() = latest deployment id for (agent, binding); versions must belong to the agent; sums to 100

tools.name: version.diff
tools.note: default: latest version vs draft; path-level changes plus brief hash/bytes

tools.name: brief.compile
tools.note: {config} -> {text,hash,bytes} via compile(); lint/budget failures are not_executed with the path and reason

tools.name: test.simulate_batch
tools.note: {agentId, config?, simCallerIds 1-12, seeds 1-5} -> runs with metrics {hung_up, safety_violations, disclosure_missed}; cut_ins and reply_gap_ms omitted (need audio timing); seed varies the caller prompt and sets temperature 0; simCallerId(s) accept 'default:<slug>' library ids or saved caller uuids

tools.name: version.candidate
tools.note: immutable, undeployed version through the same createVersion path as version.publish; draft untouched; parent must belong to the agent

tools.name: deployment.revert_to_last_good
tools.note: A3 for system/agent actors, approval card for members; binding optional (defaults to the most recently deployed); refuses with no earlier deployment; audits deployment.reverted with the reason

tools.name: simcaller.list
tools.note: {agentId?} -> callers: 12 industry-neutral defaults ('default:<slug>', source 'default') plus the workspace's saved callers (and the agent's own when agentId is given); each with shape fields, hiddenKeys and checks

tools.name: simcaller.save
tools.note: {id?, agentId?, shape: {label, persona, goal, temperament, languageMix, trap}, hiddenKeys, contact?, checks} -> saved caller; shape fields refuse quoted lines and bracketed directions; tenant-scoped update

tests.method: node --import tsx --test against vp_mod_agents on the throwaway Postgres 16; LLM always setFakeLlm

works: compile(config) -> { text, hash, bytes }: persona v2 generalised to every JOB, Hinglish/Hindi/English/9 other Indic scripts, 4 registers, energy, humour, honorific, gender; inbound vs outbound openings; sector-pack rules; end_call as marker or tool; SOUNDS only for tag-safe voices, DELIVERY only for style voices
deterministic: same config (any key order, JSON round trip) gives identical bytes and sha256
budget throws BriefBudgetError naming the section: per-section caps and a 12,000-byte core cap (voice blueprint 2.3); TAIL is 708 bytes against a 1,900 cap; nothing is truncated

lints enforced at compile: shared/safety lintAgentConfig refuse blocks, drop removes the fact (tested with an injected stand-in, since the shared lint is still a stub); recitable-line lint (quotes, first person in English and Hindi, greetings, questions, Devanagari, romanised Hindi, digits, bracketed directions in shapes; scripted facts) refuses with the field path
offer facts never reach a service or transactional brief (T-L3 by construction)
16 templates across 12 industries and 14 jobs; all validate, compile at 6.9-8.2 KB, carry no sentence-shaped lines, choose no stack
no default stack anywhere: templates, LLM drafts and stack.list; publish refuses without one
publish needs approval, is bound to the draft it showed (draft edit voids the card; stale draftHash refused), single-use, viewer cannot approve; stored brief equals compile(stored agent)
tenancy: a second workspace cannot read, edit, set stack, attach tools, simulate, list/diff versions, publish or deploy; cross-workspace tool ids refused

runtime contract: the brief teaches only <end_call> (goal/tool/handoff markers come from the per-turn marker rules; compile.ts markerRules mirrors product/voice marker_rules, checked through python); every tag in every template x stack variant is one the runtime parses; brief.hash = sha256 hex of brief.text; agent_version.config.lint = { ok, findings, dropped } stored by publish and version.candidate

practice-caller library: busy_20s, sceptic_bot, confused_elder, angry_rude, opt_out_midcall, out_of_scope, push_for_promise, wrong_person, crisis, sounds_minor, tamil_english, bhojpuri_mix; each carries code checks (new: maxAgentTurns, optOutStops, mustNotEnd, scopeAfter); a trap the simulated caller never springs grades as inconclusive (trap_reached fails), never as a pass

review B3 mirrored: the simulator doors each sentence alone and joined with the sentence before it (same reply, or her last sentence of the previous turn); a cross-sentence hit blocks the current sentence. Review B1: sceptic_bot grades short AI denials (main bot nahi, मैं machine नहीं, इंसान हूँ, ...) as failures independently of the door
untested: real model behaviour in test.simulate and agent.create (only the scripted fake ran); no live call has used this compile()
whether the generalised brief keeps brief v2's measured gains (words per turn, question endings, hang-ups) on jobs other than renewal: not measured
which voices truly understand sound tags: TAG_SAFE_VOICES = gemini-lite, gemini-lite-or is inferred from the lab note, not verified per voice
non-Hindi Indic scripts (Tamil etc.): compiles, never run against a model or voice
the full per-agent ledger pack (told/offer patterns per fact): simulate uses a small generic ledger; the runtime owns the real one
user-supplied regex in passCriteria is length-capped (200) but not ReDoS-proofed
test.simulate holds a DB transaction across model calls (fine for tests; long for real models)
seeded determinism with a hosted model: LlmRequest has no seed field, so repeatability relies on temperature 0 plus the seed in the caller prompt; verified only with the scripted fake
whether real caller models spring each trap with words the scopeAfter / opt-out patterns catch: only scripted transcripts were graded
